feedback.markdownBody:
VERIFICATION FAILED for PAN-4199 (attempt 1/3):

Failed check: vbrief-ac

Acceptance criteria check FAILED — 56/56 AC incomplete:

### Deriver reads tracker facts so closed rows drop and rows carry title and trackerUnknown (4/4 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given readTrackerIssues returns { PAN-1: { open: false } } and loadStates is left at its default, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then the lib loadIssueStatesForProject receives that issues map and PAN-1 is absent from inFlight
  - [ ] Given readTrackerIssues returns null for PAN-2, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then the PAN-2 row is present with trackerUnknown: true and title: null
  - [ ] Given readTrackerIssues returns title "Fix the thing" for PAN-3, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then the PAN-3 row has title "Fix the thing"
  - [ ] Given no readTrackerIssues dep, when the default runs for 10 ids, then readIssueFromTracker is called once per id with at most 4 calls in flight

### GET /api/flywheel/status feeds the deriver from the IssueDataService cache (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given the issue cache answers open: false for PAN-7 and open: true with title "Open thing" for PAN-8, when getFlywheelStatusPayload runs with default server deps, then it returns 200 and inFlight contains only PAN-8
  - [ ] Given the same cache, when the payload is read, then the PAN-8 row title equals "Open thing"
  - [ ] Given src/lib/flywheel/derive-status.ts, when grep searches it for "dashboard/server", then it returns no match

### Deriver reads backend panes once and reports liveAgents per row and agents on the status (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given loadStates returns state working for PAN-1 and listPanes returns [], when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then the PAN-1 row has liveAgents 0
  - [ ] Given panes for PAN-1 (working), PAN-1 (exited), and PAN-9 (not in flight), when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then agents contains exactly one entry with issueId PAN-1
  - [ ] Given the default deps, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs with at least one issue, then listPanes is called exactly once and its panes are passed to loadStates

### Deriver merges the tick in-flight list: inTick per row, tick-only rows, inFlightSource (4/4 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given lastTick.inFlight is [PAN-5] and no PAN-5 workspace exists, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then inFlight contains a PAN-5 row with inTick true and lastJournal null
  - [ ] Given a census workspace PAN-6 not in the tick list, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then the PAN-6 row has inTick false
  - [ ] Given no conversation row, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then inFlightSource is census; given a conversation and a tick, then inFlightSource is tick
  - [ ] Given a tick id whose derived state is closed, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then that id is absent from inFlight

### Conversation summary carries createdAt (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a conversation row with createdAt 2026-09-23T08:00:00.000Z, when deriveFlywheelStatus runs, then status.conversation.createdAt equals that value
  - [ ] Given the contract test fixture, when decodeFlywheelDerivedStatus decodes a running status without createdAt, then it throws

### pan flywheel status prints title, tracker-unknown, no-agent, loop marker, and in-flight source (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a status with one inTick working row with liveAgents 0 titled "Fix the thing", when pan flywheel status prints, then the output contains "no agent", "Fix the thing", and "in flight (loop) 1"
  - [ ] Given a row with trackerUnknown true, when pan flywheel status prints, then that row line contains "(tracker unknown)"
  - [ ] Given inFlightSource census with 3 rows, when pan flywheel status prints, then the output contains "feature workspaces 3"

### Idle empty state names the conversation pane toolbar instead of "Start below" (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given status.run is idle, when FlywheelStatusPane renders, then the text "conversation pane's toolbar" is present
  - [ ] Given status.run is idle, when FlywheelStatusPane renders, then the text "Start below" is absent

### In-flight table renders the title and a tracker-unknown marker (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a row with title "Fix the thing", when the Status pane renders, then that text is shown and its element has title="Fix the thing"
  - [ ] Given a row with trackerUnknown true, when the Status pane renders, then an element with testid flywheel-tracker-unknown-<id> shows "tracker unknown"
  - [ ] Given a row with title null and no trackerUnknown, when the Status pane renders, then no title element and no tracker-unknown marker render for it

### In-flight table shows no-agent and loop markers; header count follows inFlightSource (4/4 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a working row with liveAgents 0, when the Status pane renders, then testid flywheel-no-agent-<id> shows "no agent"; given liveAgents 1, then it is absent
  - [ ] Given a row with inTick true, when the Status pane renders, then testid flywheel-in-tick-<id> shows "flywheel"
  - [ ] Given inFlightSource tick with 2 of 3 rows inTick, when FlywheelPage renders, then flywheel-inflight-count reads "2 in flight (loop)"
  - [ ] Given inFlightSource census with 3 rows, when FlywheelPage renders, then flywheel-inflight-count reads "3 feature workspaces"

### Status tab lists live agents for the in-flight issues (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given status.agents has two entries, when the Status pane renders, then the Live agents section shows both issue ids, roles, models, and states
  - [ ] Given an agent row, when its issue button is clicked, then onNavigateIssue is called with that issue id
  - [ ] Given status.agents is empty, when the Status pane renders, then the text "No agent panes are live for these issues." is shown

### A 409 FlywheelOrphanSession on Start offers Start fresh in the idle toolbar (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given run idle and POST /api/flywheel/start answering 409 { code: "FlywheelOrphanSession" }, when Start is clicked, then a Start fresh button appears in the Flywheel controls toolbar
  - [ ] Given that Start fresh button, when it is clicked and the confirm dialog is accepted, then POST /api/flywheel/start is sent with body { fresh: true }
  - [ ] Given a start that fails with a 500, when Start is clicked, then no Start fresh button appears in the idle toolbar

### Conversation-pane header shows live harness and model; page header shows elapsed run time (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a running status whose conversation has harness claude-code and model claude-opus-5-5, when the conversation pane renders, then flywheel-live-conversation reads "claude-code · claude-opus-5-5"
  - [ ] Given a running status whose conversation createdAt is two hours before now, when FlywheelPage renders, then flywheel-elapsed reads "running 2h 0m"
  - [ ] Given run paused, when FlywheelPage renders, then flywheel-elapsed is absent

### Left rail shows the UAT batches card over MergeTrainView (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given /api/merge-train/queues returns 2 queued features and /generations 1 ready batch, when FlywheelUatBatchesCard renders, then the card label "UAT batches" and count "2 features · 1 batch" are shown
  - [ ] Given empty queues and generations, when the card renders, then the label renders and flywheel-uat-batches-count is absent
  - [ ] Given run idle, when FlywheelPage renders, then a region labelled "UAT batches" is present

### Status tab shows the derived headline strip (4/4 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given stats with c1 denominator 12 and 3 bugs of which 2 have closedAt, when the strip renders, then flywheel-headline-prs shows 12 and flywheel-headline-fixed shows 2
  - [ ] Given orderBook { landed: 4, total: 9 }, when the strip renders, then flywheel-headline-orderbook shows "4/9"; given orderBook null, then it is absent
  - [ ] Given /api/flywheel/stats answering 500, when the strip renders, then flywheel-headline-prs shows "—"
  - [ ] Given merge-train queues with 3 features, when the strip renders, then flywheel-headline-uat shows 3

### Rail gains a Report tab rendering .pan/flywheel/report.md (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given GET /api/flywheel/report returns exists true with markdown "# Run report", when FlywheelReportPane renders, then the heading "Run report" and the path .pan/flywheel/report.md are shown
  - [ ] Given GET /api/flywheel/report returns exists false, when FlywheelReportPane renders, then "No report yet" is shown
  - [ ] Given FlywheelPage, when the rail tablist renders, then it has four tabs: status, state, report, stats

### App header needs-you indicator reveals the Status tab needs-you block (4/4 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a status with no tick needs-you and no needs-you rows, when NeedsYouIndicator renders, then it renders nothing
  - [ ] Given a tick needs-you and one row with attention needs-you, when NeedsYouIndicator renders, then it shows the count 2
  - [ ] Given the indicator, when it is clicked, then onActivate is called and consumePendingReveal() returns true once
  - [ ] Given a pending reveal and FlywheelPage showing the state tab, when the reveal fires, then the status tab is selected

### No-loss table asserts every restored affordance (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given the no-loss table, when vitest runs it, then every row including "UAT batches card", "headline strip", "report viewer", and "needs-you indicator" resolves its view export as a function
  - [ ] Given the no-loss table, when vitest runs it, then the row-count assertion equals the number of NO_LOSS entries (15)

### docs/FLYWHEEL.md documents every new derived field and restored surface (3/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given docs/FLYWHEEL.md, when grep counts Sources rows starting with Title, No agent, Loop in-flight, Live agents, Headline strip, UAT batches, Report tab, Needs-you indicator, and Elapsed, then it returns 9
  - [ ] Given docs/FLYWHEEL.md, when the In-flight issues row is read, then it names the IssueDataService cache (dashboard) and readIssueFromTracker (CLI) as the tracker sources
  - [ ] Given docs/FLYWHEEL.md Known limits, when read, then it states that elapsed counts from the conversation creation time

## REQUIRED: Complete all acceptance criteria BEFORE resubmitting

1. Review the incomplete AC above
2. Implement the missing requirements and write tests
3. Close every completed task with `pan task close` — the canonical writer publishes the close and AC statuses sync automatically; never hand-edit spec files
4. Commit and push ALL changes
5. ONLY THEN resubmit: pan review request PAN-4199 -m "Completed acceptance criteria"

Do NOT resubmit until all AC are completed.
